programs.name: Computer Science BSc
programs.ib_offer: Pass, with 34 points overall, with 17 points required at Higher Level including 6 at Higher Level in Mathematics (Analysis and Approaches) or 7 at Higher Level in Mathematics (Applications and Interpretation)
programs.ap_offer: Southampton's United States page: for courses requiring an AAB: 3 AP tests at scores of 5, 5, 4; or 2 AP tests at 5, 5 plus either an ACT score of 27 to 29 or an SAT score of 1300 to 1350; or a GPA of 3.2 in college-level classes; or predominately A grades in Honors classes. 1 AP or Honors course can be swapped for 1 ACT/SAT score, but SAT/ACT cannot meet subject-specific requirements: Maths must be met with the correct AP subject or IB Higher Level.
programs.required_subjects: Mathematics (A at A level); GCSE English language and mathematics grade 4/C
programs.toefl_note: TOEFL iBT (English language band C, IELTS 6.5 / 6.0): tests before 21 Jan 2026 (0-120 scale) 92 overall with Listening 21, Reading 22, Writing 21, Speaking 23; tests on or after 21 Jan 2026 (1-6 scale) 4.5 overall with 4.0 in each of Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking.
programs.english_note: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.0 in reading, writing, speaking and listening (English language band C). Duolingo English Test 120 and PTE Academic (non-UKVI) 67 are also listed; see the band score page.
programs.notes: Campus: Highfield. Applicants without A-level maths can apply for the Engineering/Physics/Mathematics Foundation Year (per the page). Contextual offers exist (lower than the typical offer). AP route: https://www.southampton.ac.uk/international/entry-qualification-equivalencies/united-states . English scores: https://www.southampton.ac.uk/international/english-language-requirements/test-band-scores . 2027/28 entry requirements per the course page. International fee: the page's fees block gives no year label (the course page is for entry in academic year 2027 to 2028); check the fees page before relying on it.

programs.name: Economics BSc
programs.a_level_offer: AAB including Mathematics (four A levels: standard offer plus an alternative offer of ABBB including Maths)

programs.english_note: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.0 in reading, writing, speaking and listening (English language band C). Duolingo English Test 120 and PTE Academic (non-UKVI) 67 are also listed; see the band score page.

programs.name: Mechanical Engineering BEng
programs.a_level_offer: AAA including mathematics and physics, with a pass in the physics Practical (where it is separately endorsed)
programs.ib_offer: Pass, with 36 points overall with 18 points required at Higher Level, including 6 at Higher Level in Physics and 6 at Higher Level in Mathematics (Analysis and Approaches) or 7 at Higher Level in Mathematics (Applications and Interpretation)
programs.ap_offer: Southampton's United States page: for courses requiring an AAA: 3 AP tests at scores of 5, 5, 5; or 2 AP tests at 5, 5 plus either an ACT score of 29 or an SAT score of 1350; or a GPA of 3.4 in college-level classes; or A grades in Honors classes. 1 AP or Honors course can be swapped for 1 ACT/SAT score, but SAT/ACT cannot meet subject-specific requirements: Maths and Physics must be met with the correct AP subject or IB Higher Level.
programs.required_subjects: Mathematics and physics (A level, with a physics Practical pass where endorsed); GCSE English language and mathematics grade 4/C
programs.toefl_note: TOEFL iBT (English language band C, IELTS 6.5 / 6.0): tests before 21 Jan 2026 (0-120 scale) 92 overall with Listening 21, Reading 22, Writing 21, Speaking 23; tests on or after 21 Jan 2026 (1-6 scale) 4.5 overall with 4.0 in each of Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking.
programs.english_note: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.0 in reading, writing, speaking and listening (English language band C). Duolingo English Test 120 and PTE Academic (non-UKVI) 67 are also listed; see the band score page.
programs.notes: BEng chosen as the 3-year course; the MEng (4 years) is a separate page. Campus: Highfield and Boldrewood. Applicants without A-level maths/physics can apply for the Engineering/Physics/Mathematics Foundation Year (per the page). AP route: https://www.southampton.ac.uk/international/entry-qualification-equivalencies/united-states . English scores: https://www.southampton.ac.uk/international/english-language-requirements/test-band-scores . 2027/28 entry requirements per the course page. International fee: the page's fees block gives no year label (the course page is for entry in academic year 2027 to 2028); check the fees page before relying on it.
